description: This file defines an in-memory test double class for CalendarSyncConfig used in unit testing. It provides methods to get, set, and manage configuration data related to calendar synchronization, replacing database access for testing purposes.

classes.name: InMemoryCalendarSyncConfig
classes.description: A mock implementation of CalendarSyncConfig for use in unit tests that maintains configuration in-memory.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieve a configuration value by key.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Set multiple configuration values at once.

methods.name: getRunAsyncValue
methods.description: Determine if async sync is enabled based on config.

methods.name: enableCalendarSyncLogicHooks
methods.description: Check if logic hooks are enabled for calendar sync.

methods.name: setConfigValue
methods.description: Set a specific configuration value by key.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Reset configuration data to default values.
